title: anatherum glabrum
intro: Anatherum glabrum, commonly known as White Grass or African Rye Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to possess various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Anatherum glabrum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Anatherum glabrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
